evals.name: android-balanced-autonomous
evals.prompt: I have an Android app project at fixtures/android-app/ and the implementation plan for user authentication is at features/user-auth/. Set up the harness so I can start implementing autonomously. I want balanced quality — not too slow but catch real problems. Claude should commit freely without asking. Don't touch the plan files. I'll review PRs myself before merging.
evals.expected_output: Should produce: augmented CLAUDE.md with gradle build/test commands, .harness/feature-list.json with 6 tasks converted from tasks.md, hooks for build verification and test gates, eval criteria focused on Android/Compose quality dimensions, session-startup.md checklist, sprint contract template. Should detect Android/Kotlin/Compose domain automatically.

assertions.text: feature-list.json exists and is valid JSON
all tasks start with passes: false
CLAUDE.md exists and contains gradlew build command
analysis.json exists and is valid JSON
spec protection hook present (user said don't touch plan files)

evals.name: nextjs-codex-plugin-thorough
evals.prompt: Configure the harness for the Next.js dashboard at fixtures/nextjs-dashboard/. Plan is in .specs/features/dashboard/. Thorough quality bar with the full evaluation loop. I have Playwright MCP available AND the OpenAI Codex Plugin for Claude Code is installed (codex-plugin-cc, so /codex:review and /codex:adversarial-review are available). I also have the codex CLI directly. Set up the harness to use the Codex Plugin for reviews (not just codex exec), include adversarial review for thorough evaluation, and document the stop gate as an option for critical features. I want 3-tier verdicts (not just pass/fail), timestamped evaluation reports that preserve history, and an evaluator tuning log for calibration adjustments.
evals.expected_output: Should produce full harness with Codex Plugin integration: eval-criteria.md with 3-tier verdict (PASS/REVISE/FAIL) and optional dimension weights, evaluator-prompt.md mentioning Playwright, evaluation-report-template.md with timestamped pattern and Score Trend section, evaluator-tuning-log.md template, sprint-contract.md with verification table AND Definition of Done. Session-startup.md should mention eval-reports/ directory (not single file), include stop gate opt-in step, and reference /codex:adversarial-review. analysis.json should record codex_plugin=true. AGENTS.md should be generated.

assertions.text: feature-list.json exists and is valid JSON
session-startup or evaluator-prompt references /codex:adversarial-review or adversarial
session-startup mentions stop gate as opt-in

evals.name: bare-api-eval-loop-no-ui
evals.prompt: Configure the harness for the Python FastAPI project at fixtures/bare-api/. Plan is in features/api-v2/. I want balanced quality with the evaluation loop enabled, but this is an API-only project — no UI, no browser, no mobile. I have codex CLI available (no plugin, no gemini). Set up the evaluation loop adapted for API testing: the evaluator should test endpoints via HTTP, check logs, verify database state — not try to open a browser. I want 3-tier verdicts, timestamped reports, and the evaluator prompt adapted specifically for API/backend evaluation patterns.
evals.expected_output: Should produce harness with API-adapted evaluation loop: evaluator-prompt.md focused on HTTP testing (curl, API endpoints) NOT Playwright/browser. eval-criteria.md with backend dimensions (API correctness, error handling, performance) and 3-tier verdict. Sprint contract with API-specific verification criteria. analysis.json should show platform=api. No launch-app.sh for browser, but may have one for starting the API server. Session-startup with eval report check. Project-specific Python/FastAPI adaptations.

assertions.text: feature-list.json exists and is valid JSON
evaluator prompt focuses on API/HTTP testing
evaluator prompt does NOT mention Playwright or browser
evaluator prompt has Python/FastAPI specific content
